summary: Becton Dickinson & Co and its wholly-owned subsidiary Becton Dickinson Euro Finance S.à r.l. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement for the issuance of €600M aggregate principal amount of 3.855% Notes due 2033 (Euro Notes), fully and unconditionally guaranteed by BD. Net proceeds, together with cash on hand, will be used to repay €1.208% Euro Notes due June 4, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing transaction; no special situation event. The offering is expected to close on May 20, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
